1. Correction

No prior statement on this ticket needs correction.

2. Environment and steps to reproduce

Environment: Production, Loblaw tenant (Client ID 212).

Loblaw, reported 2026-09-15

  1. Open Krysten Dyer's saved searches, enter the "Ticket Searches" folder and look for searches that contain the text: Gift Card and Tender Table 2026-09-15

  2. You'll find 2 different saved searches. Select one of them and run it.

  3. Notice all records share the same value on the Account Number column.

  4. Open the transaction viewer and look for the GIFT CARD section right under the total.

  5. Notice only one gift card is listed despite using multiple.

Expected: the Account Number field should display the same value as the Card No field. Also, all redeemed gift cards should be listed in the GIFT CARD section.

 

3. Findings

Gift card data is present but its not being displayed correctly on the results grid and the GIFT CARD section of the transaction viewer.

 

Related tickets: https://trebuco.atlassian.net/browse/RCS-18823 , https://trebuco.atlassian.net/browse/RCS-19374
